title: A remark on isolated complex hypersurface singularities
summary: This is now an expository note about the following classical problem. Let $(X, \bf 0)$ be the germ of a hypersurface in $(\mathbb C^n,\bf 0)$ with an ordinary singularity of multiplicity $m$ at the origin $\bf 0$. A natural question to ask is whether $X$ and its tangent cone at the origin are analytically isomorphic. The answer is negative in general, in view of a theorem of Kioji Saito.
